# Brian Ward Appraisal — Chula Vista & San Diego County Real Estate Appraiser

> California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser serving Chula Vista, the South Bay, and all of San Diego County since 2004. 20+ years of experience and 7,000+ appraisals completed. Specializing in non-lender appraisals: date-of-death, divorce, estate and trust, bankruptcy, expert witness, pre-purchase, and pre-sale valuations. All reports comply with USPAP.

## Key Facts
- Business: Brian Ward Appraisal
- Primary / parent website: https://www.brianward.com (Brian Ward Appraisal, serving San Diego & Riverside Counties). This site, chula-vista.pro, is the Chula Vista / San Diego County presence of the same business; brianward.com is the main, authoritative site.
- Appraiser credential: California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser
- Phone: (619) 330-9406
- Email: contact@chula-vista.pro
- Service area: All of San Diego County, California (Chula Vista and the South Bay, the City of San Diego and its neighborhoods, the coast, East County, North County coastal and inland, and the backcountry)
- Pricing: Residential appraisals from $299 (Basic Desktop) to $725 (Standard 2–4 Unit). Exact fee quoted before commitment.

## Pricing
- Basic Desktop: $299 — Records-based valuation with no property visit. MLS data, county records, and recent comparable sales analysis.
- Desktop Appraisal: $449 — Enhanced records review, neighborhood analysis, and detailed comparable sales study. No property visit.
- Drive-By Appraisal: $575 — Exterior-only inspection with photographs. Includes property condition notes and full market analysis.
- Standard (Single Family): $625 — Full interior and exterior inspection with detailed property photographs. Complete narrative appraisal report.
- Desktop (2–4 Unit): $550 — Multi-unit records-based valuation with separate unit analysis. No property visit.
- Standard (2–4 Unit): $725 — Multi-unit full interior and exterior inspection. Separate unit analysis and complete narrative report.

## Services
- [Date of Death Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/date-of-death-appraisals): Retrospective date-of-death appraisals for estate settlement, IRS reporting, and stepped-up basis in Chula Vista and across San Diego County. USPAP-compliant, court- and IRS-ready.
- [Divorce Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/divorce-appraisals): Neutral, court-accepted divorce appraisals for family-law matters in Chula Vista and San Diego County. Current or date-of-separation value, expert testimony, two-party discount.
- [Estate & Trust Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/estate-trust-appraisals): Probate, trust distribution, and estate appraisals in Chula Vista and San Diego County. Current and retrospective values for courts, trustees, attorneys, and beneficiaries.
- [Bankruptcy Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/bankruptcy-appraisals): Independent bankruptcy appraisals accepted by trustees and the bankruptcy court in Chula Vista and San Diego County. USPAP-compliant residential valuations, prompt turnaround.
- [Expert Witness & Litigation Support](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/expert-witness): Expert-witness appraisal testimony and litigation support for property disputes, tax appeals, and contested valuations in Chula Vista and San Diego County.
- [Pre-Purchase Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/pre-purchase-appraisals): Independent pre-purchase appraisals in Chula Vista and San Diego County. Know a property's true value before you buy and avoid overpaying.
- [Pre-Sale Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/pre-sale-appraisals): Pre-sale and pre-listing appraisals in Chula Vista and San Diego County. Set a realistic asking price with an independent certified valuation.
- [Tax Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/tax-appraisals): Property-tax appeal and gift-tax appraisals in Chula Vista and San Diego County for the county assessor and the IRS.
- [Family Transaction Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/family-transaction-appraisals): IRS-compliant family-transaction appraisals for sales, gifts, and transfers between family members in Chula Vista and San Diego County.
- [Insurance Dispute Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/insurance-dispute-appraisals): Insurance claim and coverage-dispute appraisals in Chula Vista and San Diego County. Independent valuations that address policy limits and help resolve claims.
- [Bail Bond Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/bail-bond-appraisals): Bail-bond property appraisals in Chula Vista and San Diego County. Reports accepted by courts and bonding companies to verify real-estate equity.
- [Immigration Appraisals](https://www.chula-vista.pro/services/immigration-appraisals): Immigration appraisals for USCIS petitions, visa applications, and residency proceedings in Chula Vista and San Diego County.
